notes.title: Advent: Dawn DEMO out now!
notes.content:
The Advent: Dawn demo is now available for download! 
We’re proud to announce the first playable demo of our upcoming title. The demo is about 30-minutes to complete and roughly covers the first 4-hours of the in-game journey. It introduces the characters, the setting, and ends with the climactic "inciting event".  

The demo and full release will both be fully compatible with the Steam Deck. Please contact us through a community post or on Discord if you have any challenges or bugs.  

Please note this demo will only be available for the next few months. Enjoy!  

-Spire Games.
